TEAM RELAY 台風の目

Typhoon Race

Five players, one long pole. Circle cone 1, run diagonally to the left of cone 2, then U-turn and run straight back. Sweep the pole low and high, then pass it on.

  • 3 teams
  • 5 per group
  • 1 long pole

Watch a clip

0:30

How to play

Tap a card to play or pause its animation.

    Whole course

    Top view
    WAITING START/FINISH CONE 1 CONE 2 U-TURN

      NOW

      Gold sashes mark each team’s last group. This example shows six groups per team.

      Rules

      Teams & lanes

      • All 3 teams race at once, one lane each.
      • 5 players share one pole.
      • Line up one group per row. The front row goes next.

      Cone route

      • Run to cone 1 and circle it once.
      • Run diagonally to the left of cone 2.
      • U-turn around cone 2, then run straight back.

      Pole sweep & handoff

      • The middle three step aside. The two end players sweep the pole.
      • Sweep low toward the back. Waiting players jump over the pole.
      • Sweep high back to the front. Waiting players duck.
      • Set the pole down at the start for the next group.

      Penalties & finish

      • Lose your grip or drop the pole? Grab it and keep going. No penalty.
      • Pole hits a waiting player? Keep going. No penalty.
      • Each team’s last group wears sashes.
      • The first sash group back across the start line wins. Rank the other teams by finish order.

      Overall Point

      Teams earn overall points based on the order their final sash groups cross back over the start line. The first team to finish earns 50 overall points.

      1. 1st50 pts
      2. 2nd40 pts
      3. 3rd20 pts

      Referee ruling

      Skipped cone
      If a group misses a cone, the referee will require you to circle back to the cone and complete the turn.

      TEAM THROW 玉入れ

      Beanbag Toss

      Ten throwers per team, one basket, two minutes. Score from outside the circle while three teammates inside return fallen beanbags.

      • 3 teams
      • 10 throwers per team
      • 4 matches
      • 100 beanbags each

          NOW

          1. White Team0

          Organizer holding the basket Referee or guide

          Rules

          Teams & matches

          • 4 matches, 2 min each
          • All 3 teams throw at once
          • 10 outside throwers per team, each match
          • Players picked on game day. Everyone plays once.

          Beanbags

          • 100 beanbags per team
          • They start on the circle line
          • Pick up beanbags from the line. Throw from outside.
          • Any beanbag color is fine

          The circle

          • 5 m circle around the basket
          • 3 teammates help inside. The organizer in green holds the basket.
          • Helpers toss fallen beanbags back to teammates outside.
          • Helpers keep other teammates outside and never throw into the basket.

          What counts

          • Whistle starts and ends the match
          • Only beanbags thrown into the basket from outside count.
          • Thrown after the end? Doesn’t count.
          • One referee or guide per team watches for fouls.

          Overall Point

          1 beanbag is worth 1 match point. Add up the match points from all 4 matches. The team with the most match points takes 1st place and earns 50 overall points.

          1. 1st50 pts
          2. 2nd40 pts
          3. 3rd20 pts

          If totals are tied

          Extra round
          Tied teams play 1 more round of 1 minute. Each team leader picks 10 players.
          Still tied?
          Play again.

          TEAM RELAY ムカデ競争

          Centipede Race

          Four players, two planks. Walk in step to the next handoff point. All six groups go in the same direction, and the team whose 6th group crosses the finish line first wins.

          • 3 teams
          • 4 per group
          • 6 groups
          • 2 planks

          Watch a clip

            Top view

              NOW

              1. White Team0/6
              2. Red Team0/6
              3. Blue Team0/6

              Groups finished. Faded groups have already walked.

              Rules

              Teams & groups

              • All 3 teams race at once, one lane each
              • 4 players per group
              • 6 groups per team, so 24 players run
              • Group order is decided on the spot

              Planks

              • 2 planks per team
              • One foot on each plank
              • No cones and no long pole

              The relay

              • All six groups walk in the same direction
              • Same distance for every group
              • Hand the planks over at the next handoff point. Group 6 crosses the finish line.

              Fell off?

              • Put the planks back on
              • Carry on from the same spot
              • No penalty

              Overall Point

              Teams earn overall points based on the order they finish.

              1. 1st50 pts
              2. 2nd40 pts
              3. 3rd20 pts

              LEAF TAG

              Dondarm Slerk Cher

              When your number is called, run into the circle. Grab the leaf and carry it past the circle’s edge before an opponent tags you.

              • 3 teams
              • 2 rounds
              • 7 m radius
              • 90 s per set

              Watch a clip

              0:10

              How to play

              Tap a card to play or pause its animation.

                The circle

                Top view

                  NOW

                  The small squares show 10 waiting players per team in this example. The timeout example is sped up.

                  Rules

                  Teams & rounds

                  • White Team, Red Team, and Blue Team
                  • Play 2 rounds. Each team sends one group per round.
                  • Line up outside the circle with a small gap from the line.
                  • The set count depends on the number of players from each team that round. If each team has 5 players, play 5 sets.

                  Calling numbers

                  • Number the players before each round.
                  • Call numbers in random order.
                  • On each call, one player with that number enters per team.
                  • Stalemate? The game master may call extra numbers one at a time to help retrieve the leaf.

                  Taking the leaf

                  • First to grab the leaf in the center holds it.
                  • Stealing is allowed. Grab it together? Tug or let go.
                  • Tag by touching an opponent who is still inside and has touched the leaf or is holding it.
                  • Only players inside may block someone’s path out.
                  • No pushing or tackling anyone.

                  Winning a set

                  • 1 shared circle with a 7 m radius.
                  • Any team can win by carrying the leaf past any point on the circle.
                  • A valid tag wins the set for the tagger’s team.
                  • Only one team can win a set. If the 90-second clock runs out, no team earns a point.

                  Overall Point

                  Record each set win and its time. The MC announces the total wins from both rounds. The team with the most set wins takes 1st place and earns 50 overall points.

                  1. 1st50 pts
                  2. 2nd40 pts
                  3. 3rd20 pts

                  If totals are tied

                  Tiebreak set
                  Each team picks one player for a final set.
